title: It’s Not Who You Know—It’s Who Knows You: Employee Social Capital and Firm Performance
authors: DuckKi Cho; Lyungmae Choi; Michael G. Hertzel; Jessie Jiaxu Wang
eligible_reason: Main tables relate firm Tobin's q to continuous employee-social-capital measures. The causal test (Tables 5, 6, 8) is a continuous-exposure DiD: reg f_q frac_kim2015 c.frac_kim2015#kimpost + time-varying controls with industry-by-year FE, around the 2016 Kim Young-ran Act (kimpost = fyear >= 2015, common date). Table 6 PSM sample and dynamic interactions keep continuous exposure; Table 7 is a cross-sectional announcement-return event study. Continuous treatment, single date, no firm FE.
design_notes: Stata (ESC_MS.do) and SAS data prep. Korean listed firms 2010-2018.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: continuous exposure x single post date (2016 Act); time-varying controls; industry-year FE without firm FE

data_files_note: Readme PDF: datasets for Tables 5-8 and Figure 2 shipped; individual network data for Tables 1-4 confidential (Deg_by_Emp_MS.dta not shared).
data_provenance_note: Authors' firm-year analysis data shipped for Tables 5-8; network-level inputs withheld.
